Source, fonts and notices from the published `remarkable-rm` 0.1.1 crate,
upstream revision [a40e3f58](https://github.com/citizen-stig/remarkable-tablet-cli-rs/tree/a40e3f58d370837bc4e59647bbff00eaf5e3596d/crates/remarkable-rm).

and outlined text from the existing renderer for the document viewer. The
default PNG renderer continues using the same pen styles and compositing.
